knownLimitations.reason: MmsServerConnection_sendInformationReportListOfVariables encodes a wrong length (2 trailing bytes); the adapter sends only VMD named-list reports
LIB61850-557 rejects initialPosition past EOF, but an in-range position is still not seeked; the test asserts the unseeked content
only scopeOfDelete specific is implemented; bulk deletes are answered with an Access-class ServiceError
the server fetches the source file from the client with FileOpen/FileRead (role reversal), which go-mms does not serve; the request fails with a File-class ServiceError
the client's FileOpen response handler leaves lastModified uninitialised when the optional field is absent; the test asserts size and content only
iec61850bean server does not expose SBOw[CO] as a writable MMS attribute

mms.ParseAlternateAccess refuses a selection of more than one element (ErrAlternateAccessUnsupported); the adapter answers DataAccessError object-access-unsupported. Single elements and components work

knownLimitations.capability: Alternate access read/write (array element, index range, component)
knownLimitations.reason: mms.Conn Read and Write take whole variables only; the client emits ok:false error unsupported for these steps

knownLimitations.capability: Write to a named variable list
knownLimitations.reason: mms.Conn Write takes a list of variables, not a variableListName; the step is unsupported and the reads that check its effect (including the InformationReport values) see the unwritten values
the client has no aa-specific ObjectName or name-list scope; define, attributes, read, write, delete and get-name-list in aa scope are unsupported
FileOpenAt drops the lastModified attribute of the response; the client reports 0
the server builds the type description from the value, so an Enum (INT8) is described as Integer(32) and iec61850bean cannot map the node; libiec61850 clients are not affected

knownLimitations.capability: Write of FC ST (and the dchg report it would trigger)
knownLimitations.reason: server.WithWritableFCs ignores ST/MX/OR/EX/SG by design (status is read-only in IEC 61850-7-2), so the write is always object-access-denied; the libiec61850 server denies it as well today

knownLimitations.capability: SetURCBValues RptEna=true without prior Resv (implicit URCB reservation)
knownLimitations.reason: the upstream reporting service follows Edition 2.1 strictly: RptEna on an unreserved URCB is refused with object-access-denied, so enable-only clients (libiec61850 style) get access-denied

knownLimitations.capability: Write of FC ST (and the dchg report it would trigger)
knownLimitations.reason: the upstream server always denies ST writes (object-access-denied); the libiec61850 and dscsystems servers deny it as well
the upstream MMS client has no abort primitive; the adapter's abort step only closes the transport (output line unchanged)
role reversal: go-mms does not serve files, so the server answers a File-class error (file-other) after 5 s, as libiec61850 does
answered object-access-unsupported, as libiec61850 does

knownLimitations.capability: Sampled Values ASDUs carrying smpMod (the generic stream, MSVCB02)
knownLimitations.reason: SVReceiver accepts smpMod only as one octet and drops an ASDU whose smpMod has two, which libiec61850's own SVPublisher and dscsystems send (iec61850-rust sends one octet); the subscriber reports and counts nothing of such a stream
the MS OptFlds attribute of MSVCB02 reads as a 10-bit bit-string; the libiec61850 IED server returns 5 bits (refresh-time, reserved, sample-rate, data-set, security)
iec61850bean has no SV publisher, subscriber or SVCB model: its image has no SV commands and its IED server does not expose MSVCB02
the upstream server does not model SampledValueControl blocks as MMS variables (the SCL parser builds them, no server code reads them): reading MSVCB02 attributes fails with object-non-existent

knownLimitations.capability: More than 10 ASDUs per SV frame
knownLimitations.reason: iec61850-sv encodes and decodes at most 10 ASDUs per frame (MAX_ASDU_PER_FRAME): --no-asdu is limited to 1..10 and a frame with more ASDUs is rejected
iec61850-hal's AF_PACKET socket does not expose its descriptor, so the receive buffer stays at the kernel default (about 40 ms of a 9-2LE stream); a longer subscriber stall drops samples
sv.Parse returns smpRate 0 and datSet "" for absent fields, so a present smpRate of 0 or an empty datSet is reported as null

svcbOverMms.description: Whether the stack's IED server exposes the SampledValueControl blocks of the IED fixture (LLN0$MS$MSVCB02) as MMS variables. Checked by reading SvEna, MsvID, DatSet, ConfRev, SmpRate, OptFlds, SmpMod, DstAddress and noASDU with FC MS.
